status tags with glass bubble

Motion·by @Designownow_·2026-08-18·inspora page·original post

What it is

Status tags with glass bubble: six pastel glassmorphic status pills (Pending orange, Success mint, In review yellow, Paused purple, In progress blue, Error pink, each with a tiny icon) on a soft grey field; hovering a pill summons a frosted-glass tooltip bubble with the status name (colored dot + label) and a one-line description, tail pointing at the pill; bubble follows hover between pills with a spring.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
'In review' hovered: glass bubble above reads 'This file is currently being reviewed by the team.' with yellow dot; pill glows its tint.
20-40%
Bubble re-anchors to 'In progress' ('This project is active and currently in the works.'), sliding/resizing to the new pill.
40-60%
'Paused' ('This project is currently on hold.') and 'Success' ('This document has been downloaded to the cloud.') bubbles shown in turn.
60-100%
'Error' bubble below the row ('The system can't process your file for unknown reasons.'); pills idle - soft inner glow, colored borders at 40% alpha.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: status tags with a glass bubble - six pastel glassmorphic status pills (Pending orange, Success mint, In review yellow, Paused purple, In progress blue, Error pink, each with a tiny icon) on a soft grey field; hovering a pill summons a frosted-glass tooltip bubble (colored dot + status name + one-line description, tail pointing at the pill) that follows hover between pills with a spring.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Soft grey field. Six glass pills in a row: soft inner glow, colored borders at 40% alpha, tiny icon + label each. The bubble: frosted glass, colored dot, status name, one-line description ("This file is currently being reviewed by the team."), tail pointing at the pill (Error's bubble renders below the row).

## Motion spec
Pattern: shared tooltip with spring re-anchoring.
- Hover: bubble appears above the pill (250ms spring, damping ~0.7 - one soft overshoot); the pill's glow intensifies in its tint.
- Hover moves: the bubble slides and resizes to the new pill (same spring); dot color + texts crossfade (150ms).
- Un-hover: bubble fades (150ms).

## Calibration
- Spring damping ~0.7: the bubble should visibly glide and settle, not snap.
- Text crossfade 150ms lags the bubble's arrival by ~30ms - content lands after the container.
- Bubble width adapts to content per status; it morphs, it doesn't stretch text.

## Reduced motion
Bubble fades between pills (150ms) without sliding; no spring.

## Don't miss
- ONE shared bubble traveling between pills - per-pill tooltips popping independently lose the magic.
- The tail always points at the active pill, re-anchoring with the bubble.
- Each status's dot color matches its pill tint exactly.
